commands: '=== origin behavior: SNI=s6 (valid cert) + unmatched Host headers ==='

curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "Host=bogus.db101.org      -> http=%{http_code} sslverify=%{ssl_verify_result}`n" --resolve s6.eightfoldway.com:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Host: bogus.db101.org" https://s6.eightfoldway.com/
curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "Host=nope.eightfoldway.com -> http=%{http_code}`n" --resolve s6.eightfoldway.com:443:127.0.0.1 -H "Host: nope.eightfoldway.com" https://s6.eightfoldway.com/
'=== and a totally unknown SNI (what cert/handshake for a name with no binding)? ==='

curl.exe -s -o NUL -w "SNI=zzz.db101.org -> http=%{http_code} sslverify=%{ssl_verify_result}`n" --resolve zzz.db101.org:443:127.0.0.1 https://zzz.db101.org/ ; curl.exe -k -s -o NUL -w "  (k) SNI=zzz.db101.org -> http=%{http_code}`n" --resolve zzz.db101.org:443:127.0.0.1 https://zzz.db101.org/
